issues.what: almost nothing changes across the opening sequence beyond a very slow push-in, rolling waves, and drifting mist, so with sound off it reads like a static establishing plate rather than a hook that rewards staying
issues.fix: introduce an immediate, unmistakable visual change in the opening frames such as a faster push through the arch, a subject emerging from the mist, or a dramatic lighting shift

issues.where: the dark curving spires in the left half
issues.what: at phone size it is unclear whether the shapes are rock sea stacks, giant horns, or creature limbs, and there is no scale cue to immediately ground what the viewer is looking at
issues.fix: add a recognizable scale anchor such as a small vessel, birds, or clearer form detail so the subject and scale read instantly on the first frame

issues.where: the right half of the frame and overall palette
issues.what: roughly the right 40 percent of the frame is empty grey mist and clouds, and the muted grey-on-grey palette lacks a focal highlight or color contrast to stop a fast-scrolling viewer on a phone
issues.fix: reframe to eliminate the dead space on the right and introduce a stronger contrast or light accent to draw the eye immediately

issues.where: the touching tips of the main arch and the smaller inner tendril
issues.what: both the main spires and the smaller inner spike meet at tiny, awkward pinch-point tangents that feel accidental once noticed
issues.fix: separate the tips cleanly or make them clearly overlap so the silhouette reads as natural and intentional
